F1 involution frame: per-corner frame CH(t->A).H_A.CX.CH.CX (4 CX) turns every bright pair into X_F (x) prod_c Z_{A_c}; dark flag from the frame marker B_c gated by t_c-bar plus one outer m-AND per corner (reads only the 8 outer m bits); one 6-term multiplexed Rz on F (gzu/t flags).

F2 pair frame: per corner a 2-CX leg frame + type-selected C_{jA}(X) makes both partners of every bright pair equal except the flip bit F=j_b; one rccx per corner leaves the bright flag; U_B = one (g, z, t)-multiplexed X rotation of F (6 Rz), U_E = 4 phases.

per-corner 10-CX gadget (two Margolus + CX + 2 CH, partner map X on one leg, dark flag left in a corner ancilla), 5-CX fold that exposes the corner types t_c as qubits, 4-input AND of the bright flags, 12-term Walsh multiplexed Rx on j_b (CX 132).

Spectral frame: 2-CX corner frames + type-controlled CH + padding put every bright pair on one flip qubit F (H_B = kappa(t) g X_F), outer-AND dark bits, pairwise NOR flags, 14-term exact Walsh phase polynomial of the 7-point spectrum on F.

F2 pair frame (2-CX leg frame, C_t(H) C_jA(X) C_t(YH) per corner, t-preloaded rccx bright flags, 3-rccx AND) without the z flag: U_B is one 11-term Walsh multiplexed X rotation of F over (g, t1, t2, t1^t3), Gray-walked with 12 CX plus one CX(t1->t3) before and after (CX 124, reads 2 outer bits).

F2 pair frame with in-place flags: a fold schedule (cx 5>11, 8>2 give z's inputs, tau0>2, tau0>11, 5>8 give t3, t1, t2 just in time) writes three corner bright flags onto the type qubits themselves (F = j_r), and the AND gg is dropped: U_B is one 9-term Walsh rotation of F over (pa, pb, z, t2) on a 10-CX Gray cycle.

F2 pair frame (2-CX leg frame W, C_t(H), C_jA(X), C_t(YH), cx(t,b), one rccx bright flag per corner, AND tree g) without the z flag: one 11-term Walsh-multiplexed X rotation of F over (g, t1, t2, t2^t3), 12-CX Gray walk after one extra fold CX (CX 124).

F2 pair frame (2-CX leg frame + type gates + one rccx bright flag per corner) with an 8-CX type plumbing (no outer reads, corners 0/1 flag in place into their type registers) and the top AND g=pa&pb toggled into F by an in-walk rccx (no g register; residual (-1)^(pa z) fixed by one CZ); 6-Rz (g,z,t) multiplexer + 4 electric phases.

F2 pair frame with in-place flags (parent r02-F2-002) and the pair AND pa = f0 & f1 never stored: in a 10-CX Gray cycle of the 9-term Walsh rotation over (pa, pb, z, t2) pa toggles exactly twice, so both toggles are rccx(f0, f1, F) and the Margolus residual (-1)^(f0 z) (z = net toggle between them) is cancelled by one CZ; CX 119.

F2 in-place-flag pipeline with a 5-CX clean corner frame: W's two CX enclose C_t(T X T^dg), then C_j(Y_a) and C_t(S^dg H S) make bright partners equal and send diff legs off |00>, so each corner's bright flag is one rccx onto its type qubit (8 CX per corner instead of 9); U_B is one 9-term Walsh rotation of F=j_r over (pa, pb, z, t2) on a 10-CX Gray cycle (CX 112).

F4-002 frame and 8-CX plumbing (no outer reads; flags b0, b1 in place on q11, q8, flags b2, b3 in ancillas) with only pb = b2&b3 stored; U_B is F2's 9-term Walsh rotation of F = j_b over (pa, pb, z, t2) on a closed Gray walk in which pa = b0&b1 is toggled by two in-walk rccx (no pa register) and the straddled Margolus phase (-1)^(b1 pb) is cancelled by one CZ: CX 119.

F3 5-CX clean corner frame (r03-F3-003) + F2 in-walk pair AND: pa = b0 & b1 is never stored, its two toggles in the 10-CX Gray cycle of the 9-term Walsh rotation over (pa, pb, z, t2) are rccx(b0, b1, F) and the residual (-1)^(b0 z) is one CZ (CX 111).

r03-F3-003 (5-CX clean corner frame, in-place bright flags, 9-term Walsh rotation of F=j_r over (pa, pb, z, t2)) with the pair AND pa = b0 & b1 never stored: in the 10-toggle Gray cycle pa toggles exactly twice, both toggles are rccx(b0, b1, F) and the straddled Margolus residual (-1)^(b0 pb) is cancelled by one CZ (walk 15 CX, storage -6): CX 111.

F3's 5-CX clean corner frame (one rccx bright flag per corner) on F4's 8-CX no-outer-read plumbing (flags b0, b1 in place on q11, q8; b2, b3 in ancillas; t2 kept on q5) with only pb = b2&b3 stored; U_B is the 9-term Walsh rotation of F = j_b over (pa, pb, z, t2) for the F3 sign kappa = 2, -(-1)^t2, -1/2 on a closed walk in which pa = b0&b1 is toggled by two in-walk rccx and the straddled phase (-1)^(b1 pb) is cancelled by one CZ: CX 111.
